scope: private synthetic ASGI and SQLite fixtures; no application database

configuration.default_threshold: 80 percent of queue cap, rounded up; absolute event-count override

recovery_below_threshold.action: remove one synthetic event from the four-event queue

storage_failure_detection.unavailable_path_fixture: journal parent path is a regular file

limitations: a request already past preflight can finish if storage fails afterward
an empty replacement volume after process restart requires external volume monitoring to distinguish it from first use
alert transitions are application logs and health state; external paging integration is not configured
rejected mutations are not appended to the saturated journal
